title: 第003章 夜探赵府取丹劫第004章 破庙施救断腿女
lines: 天色将亮未亮，是守夜人最疲惫、警惕性最低的时刻，也是夜行者最后的活动窗口。
秦夜如同暗影，紧贴着城墙根快速移动。青云城的城墙对现在的他来说不算高，但白天攀爬容易暴露。他选择从排水涵洞潜入。涵洞狭窄，充满污秽，但对于一个能完美控制肌肉、不介意肮脏的前世顶尖杀手兼医者来说，不算障碍。
悄无声息地穿过涵洞，进入城内一条偏僻的污水沟。辨明方向后，他钻出沟渠，闪入一条无人的小巷。
身上破烂的衣服和污垢是最好的伪装。他低着头，快步穿行在黎明前最黑暗的街道，目标明确——城东，赵府。
根据赵阔昨日在百花楼“炫耀”的信息，那十颗秦家进献给城主府、又被城主转赐给护卫统领赵刚以示拉拢的淬体丹，就藏在赵府内库。
秦夜需要这些丹药。不仅是为了自己更快打通经脉，恢复修为，更是为了给阿萝治腿。淬体丹蕴含精纯药力，可固本培元，强壮气血，对外伤恢复、尤其是接骨生肌有极大助益。配合他的针法，阿萝的腿才有完全康复、不留残疾的希望。
他一边疾行，一边在脑海中调出关于赵府和赵刚的记忆碎片。赵刚，淬体五重，城主府护卫统领，擅长赵家祖传的“开山拳”，性格暴躁，对城主苏远山忠心耿耿。其子赵阔，淬体三重，标准的纨绔恶少，欺男霸女，在青云城名声极臭。赵府位于城东富贵区，但不算最顶级的府邸，护卫力量应当有限。
穿过几条街巷，远远已能看到赵府高挂的灯笼和隐约的轮廓。秦夜没有靠近正门，而是绕到府邸西侧。这边靠近一条相对安静的街道，院墙也稍矮一些。
他伏在对面一处屋脊的阴影里，仔细观察。
赵府门外有两名守卫，抱着长枪，有些昏昏欲睡。院墙内，有规律的脚步声响起，是巡逻的护卫，大约五人一队，半柱香时间经过一次。墙头没有明显的预警机关，但墙角似乎埋着防贼的碎瓷片。
防卫不算森严，但也不是不设防。对于寻常毛·贼或者淬体三四重的武者，有一定威慑。但对秦夜而言，破绽百出。
他耐心地等待巡逻队走过，计算着他们的间隔。当下一次巡逻队的脚步声远去，他如同夜枭般无声掠下屋脊，几步跨过街道，来到赵府西墙下。脚尖在墙根一点，身体轻盈拔起，左手在墙头一按，避开碎瓷片，整个人已翻入院内，落地无声，顺势滚入一丛茂密的冬青之后。
动作一气呵成，快、轻、准。
他伏在树后，感官提升到极致。院子里很安静，远处有隐约的灯火和低语，大概是厨房或者下房区域。主宅方向一片黑暗，只有檐下灯笼在夜风中微微摇晃。
内库的位置，一般会在主宅附近，且靠近主人起居之所，便于掌控。秦夜根据府邸的常规布局，判断内库可能在主宅东侧厢房或者后罩房一带。
他没有贸然行动，而是从冬青丛后摸出几颗小石子，屈指一弹。
“啪嗒。”小石子落在数丈外的鹅卵石小径上，发出轻微的声响。
“谁？！”附近月亮门后，立刻传来一声低喝，一个提着灯笼的护卫转了出来，警惕地四下张望。
秦夜屏息不动。
那护卫看了看石子落处，又看了看安静的四周，嘀咕了一句“野猫吧”，摇摇头，提着灯笼又转了回去。
调虎离山，确认暗哨位置。秦夜心里有了数。这赵府的防卫，明哨松懈，暗哨倒是安排了一个，就在通往主宅的月亮门附近。
他等那暗哨退回原位，又耐心等了片刻，直到下一队巡逻的脚步声从远处回廊传来，渐渐靠近。就在巡逻队即将拐过回廊拐角，视线即将覆盖他藏身的冬青丛的瞬间——
秦夜动了。
他如同鬼魅般从冬青丛另一侧滑出，不是冲向月亮门，而是扑向侧面一座假山。在巡逻队拐过弯、目光扫过来的前一刻，他的身影已没入假山背后的阴影中，与假山石影融为一体。
巡逻队毫无所觉，踏着整齐的步伐走了过去。
暗哨的护卫听到巡逻队的脚步声，似乎也放松了些警惕，从月亮门后探出半个身子，朝巡逻队方向点了点头，算是打招呼。
就在他探头、视线偏向巡逻队的刹那，秦夜从假山后闪出，速度快得只在空气中留下一道淡淡的残影。暗哨护卫只觉后颈微微一麻，像是被蚊子叮了一口，随即眼前一黑，软软倒下，被秦夜伸手扶住，轻轻放倒在月亮门后的阴影里，顺手拿走了他腰间的钥匙串。
秦夜看了看钥匙串，上面有七八把不同的钥匙。他拿起钥匙串，在昏迷护卫的衣领、袖口等可能沾染库房气味的地方轻轻蹭了蹭，然后放到鼻尖，凝神细闻。
前世修炼《九转生死诀》，五感远超常人，虽重生后大幅削弱，但分辨一些特殊气味仍有优势。很快，他从钥匙串上分辨出两种比较特殊的气味：一种是淡淡的、类似陈年木材和铁锈混合的气味，可能是库房门锁；另一种则是极淡的药味和金属味，很可能来自存放丹药的盒子或内库本身。
他收起钥匙串，闪身穿过月亮门，进入内院。
内院更加安静，也更为精致。主宅是一座两层小楼，黑着灯。东侧是一排厢房，西侧是花园。秦夜略一思索，朝着东厢房潜去。
他放轻脚步，贴近东厢房窗下，逐一倾听。前面两间像是书房和客厅，无人。第三间房里传出细微的、不似人睡的鼾声，还夹杂着梦呓和磨牙声。秦夜指尖凝聚一丝微不可察的真气，在窗纸上无声地捅开一个小孔，向内望去。
里面是个卧室，床上躺着一个肥硕的身影，正是赵阔。他四仰八叉地睡着，被子踢到一边，嘴角流着涎水，鼾声如雷。房间里有浓烈的酒气和脂粉气，地上还胡乱扔着几件女子的衣裳，显然昨晚又是在哪里鬼混到深夜才回来。
秦夜目光一扫，房间陈设华丽但俗气，不像是存放重要物品的地方。他正要离开，忽然心中一动。
赵阔这种人，嚣张跋扈，对父亲未必全然信任。那十颗淬体丹如此珍贵，赵刚会不会为了安抚这个儿子，或者为了激励他修炼，提前给他一两颗？又或者，以赵阔的性子，会不会偷偷从内库弄点好东西到自己房里？
他轻轻拨开窗栓——这种富家子弟，晚上睡觉很少从里面栓死窗户，尤其是喝了酒之后。窗户悄无声息地打开一条缝，秦夜如同泥鳅般滑入室内，落地无声。
他先是在房间里的桌案、抽屉、衣柜等处快速而仔细地翻查。果然，在床头一个上锁的紫檀木小匣里，发现了一些金叶子、银票，还有两瓶普通的壮骨丹，但对淬体丹，一无所获。
就在他准备放弃，去查找真正的内库时，目光落在了赵阔扔在床脚的外袍上。外袍鼓鼓囊囊，似乎内袋里有东西。
秦夜走过去，伸手探入内袋，摸到了一个冰凉坚硬的扁圆玉盒。拿出打开，一股淡淡的、比壮骨丹精纯数倍的药香溢出。玉盒内，铺着柔软的丝绸，上面静静地躺着一颗龙眼大小、色泽温润、隐隐有光华流转的丹药。
淬体丹！而且品质不错，至少是中品。
“果然。”秦夜嘴角微勾。赵阔身上果然有一颗，可能是赵刚给他的，也可能是他偷拿的。这倒是省事了。
他将这颗淬体丹收起，正准备离开，床上的赵阔忽然翻了个身，嘴里含糊地嘟囔：“小翠……爷的丹药……可金贵了……别弄丢了……”说着，手下意识地在身边摸了摸，似乎想确认什么。
content_en:
Before dawn, it is the time when the night watchman is most tired and vigilant, and it is also the last window of activity for the night walker.
Qin Ye was like a shadow, moving quickly close to the base of the city wall. The city wall of Qingyun City is not high for him now, but climbing during the day can easily expose him. He chose to sneak in through the drainage culvert. The culvert was narrow and full of filth, but it was not an obstacle for a top killer and healer in his previous life who could perfectly control his muscles and didn't mind being dirty.
Passing quietly through the culvert, we entered a remote sewage ditch in the city. After identifying the direction, he got out of the ditch and ducked into a deserted alley.
The tattered clothes and dirt on the body are the best disguise. He lowered his head and walked quickly through the darkest streets before dawn, with a clear goal-Zhao Mansion in the east of the city.
According to the information that Zhao Kuo "showed off" at Baihua Tower yesterday, the ten body tempering pills that the Qin family donated to the city lord's mansion and were given to the guard commander Zhao Gang by the city lord as a sign of win over were hidden in the inner treasury of the Zhao mansion.
Qin Ye needs these pills. Not only to open up his meridians faster and restore his cultivation level, but also to heal A Luo's legs. The Body Tempering Pill contains pure medicinal power, which can strengthen the body's vitality, strengthen Qi and blood, and is of great help in recovering from trauma, especially bone regeneration and muscle regeneration. With his acupuncture techniques, there is hope that Ah Luo's leg will fully recover without leaving any disability.
As he walked quickly, he recalled fragments of memories about Zhao Mansion and Zhao Gang in his mind. Zhao Gang, fifth level of body tempering, is the guard commander of the city lord's mansion. He is good at the "Kaishan Fist" passed down by the Zhao family. He has a violent personality and is loyal to the city lord Su Yuanshan. His son, Zhao Kuo, was at the third level of body tempering. He was a standard dandy and a bad boy, bullying men and dominating women. He had a very bad reputation in Qingyun City. The Zhao Mansion is located in the wealthy district in the east of the city, but it is not the most top-notch mansion, so the security force should be limited.
Passing through several streets and alleys, you can already see the high hanging lanterns and vague outline of Zhao Mansion in the distance. Qin Ye did not approach the main entrance, but walked around to the west side of the mansion. This side is close to a relatively quiet street, and the courtyard wall is slightly shorter.
He crouched in the shadow of a rooftop opposite and observed carefully.
There were two guards outside the Zhao Mansion, holding spears and looking a little drowsy. Within the courtyard wall, regular footsteps sounded. They were patrolling guards. There were about five people in a team, passing by once every half a stick of incense. There is no obvious early warning mechanism on the wall, but there seem to be broken pieces of porcelain buried in the corner to prevent thieves.
The defense is not too strict, but it is not undefended either. It is a certain deterrent to ordinary hairy thieves or warriors of the third and fourth levels of body tempering. But for Qin Ye, it was full of flaws.
He waited patiently for the patrol to pass, calculating the distance between them. When the footsteps of the next patrol faded away, he silently flew down the roof like a night owl, crossed the street in a few steps, and came to the west wall of Zhao Mansion. The toes were at the base of the wall, the body was lifted up lightly, and the left hand was pressed on the top of the wall to avoid the broken porcelain pieces. The whole person had rolled into the courtyard, landed silently, and rolled behind a dense bush of holly.
The movements are done in one go, fast, light and accurate.
He lay down behind a tree, his senses heightened to the extreme. The yard was very quiet, with faint lights and whispers in the distance, probably in the kitchen or lower room area. It was dark in the direction of the main house, with only the lanterns under the eaves swaying slightly in the night wind.
The location of the inner warehouse is usually near the main house and close to the owner's living room, making it easy to control. Based on the general layout of the mansion, Qin Ye judged that the inner treasury might be in the east wing or back room of the main house.
He did not act rashly, but took out a few pebbles from behind the holly bush and flicked them with his fingers.
"Plop." The pebbles landed on the cobblestone path a few feet away, making a slight sound.
"Who?!" A low shout came from behind the nearby Moon Gate, and a guard with a lantern came out and looked around warily.
Qin Ye held his breath.
The guard looked at where the pebbles fell, then looked around at the quiet surroundings, muttered "Wild cats," shook his head, and turned back with a lantern.
Move the tiger away from the mountain and confirm the location of the hidden sentry. Qin Ye had an idea in his mind. The Zhao Mansion's defense was lax, but a secret sentry was arranged near the Moon Gate leading to the main house.
He waited for the secret sentry to return to its original position, and waited patiently for a while, until the footsteps of the next patrol came from the distant corridor and gradually approached. Just when the patrol was about to turn the corner of the corridor and his sight was about to cover the holly bush where he was hiding——
Qin Ye moved.
He slipped out from the other side of the holly bush like a ghost, and instead of rushing towards the Moon Gate, he rushed towards a rockery on the side. The moment before the patrol turned the corner and glanced over, his figure had disappeared into the shadow behind the rockery and merged with the shadow of the rockery.
The patrol was unaware of it and walked over at a neat pace.
When the guard on the secret whistle heard the footsteps of the patrol, he seemed to relax his vigilance. He leaned out half of his body from behind the moon door and nodded in the direction of the patrol as a greeting.
The moment he turned his head towards the patrol, Qin Ye flashed out from behind the rockery, so fast that he only left a faint afterimage in the air. The secret guard felt a slight numbness on the back of his neck, as if he had been bitten by a mosquito. Then his vision went dark and he fell softly. Qin Ye stretched out his hand to support him, and gently laid him down in the shadow behind the moon door. He took away the keychain from his waist.
Qin Ye looked at the keychain. There were seven or eight different keys on it. He picked up the key chain, rubbed it gently on the unconscious guard's collar, cuffs and other places that might be contaminated by the smell of the warehouse, then put it to the tip of his nose and smelled it carefully.
In his previous life, he practiced the "Nine Transformations of Life and Death", and his five senses were far superior to those of ordinary people. Although they were greatly weakened after rebirth, he still had an advantage in distinguishing some special smells. Soon, he distinguished two rather special smells from the key chain: one was a faint smell, similar to a mixture of old wood and rust, which might be the warehouse door lock; the other was a very faint medicinal smell and metallic smell, which was probably coming from the box where the elixir was stored or the inner warehouse itself.
He put away the key chain, ducked through the moon gate, and entered the inner courtyard.
The inner courtyard is quieter and more refined. The main house is a two-story building with dark lights. On the east side is a row of wing rooms, and on the west side is a garden. Qin Ye thought for a moment and sneaked towards the east wing.
He walked lightly, leaned under the window of the east wing, and listened to each one one by one. The first two rooms, like a study and a living room, were empty. From the third room came subtle snoring sounds that were not like human sleep, mixed with the sounds of talking in sleep and grinding teeth. Qin Ye gathered a trace of undetectable energy on his fingertips, silently poked a small hole in the window paper, and looked inside.
Inside was a bedroom, with a plump figure lying on the bed, it was Zhao Kuo. He fell asleep with his back stretched out, the quilt kicked aside, saliva dripping from the corners of his mouth, and snoring loudly. There was a strong smell of alcohol and makeup in the room, and there were a few women's clothes scattered on the floor. It was obvious that they had been fooling around until late at night.
Qin Ye glanced around and saw that the room was gorgeously furnished but tacky, and it didn't look like a place to store important items. He was about to leave when suddenly his heart moved.
People like Zhao Kuo are arrogant and domineering, and may not fully trust his father. Those ten body tempering pills are so precious, would Zhao Gang give him one or two in advance in order to appease his son or to encourage him to practice? Or, with Zhao Kuo's temperament, would he secretly get some good things from the inner treasury and bring them to his room?
He gently opened the window bolt - a kid from a rich family rarely bolts the window from the inside when sleeping at night, especially after drinking. The window quietly opened a crack, and Qin Ye slid into the room like a loach, landing silently.
He first quickly and carefully searched the desks, drawers, wardrobes, etc. in the room. Sure enough, in a small locked rosewood box beside the bed, some gold leaves, silver notes, and two bottles of ordinary bone-strengthening pills were found, but nothing was found about the body-tempering pill.
Just when he was about to give up and search for the real inner treasure, his eyes fell on Zhao Kuo's robe thrown at the foot of the bed. The outer robe is bulging, as if there is something in the inner pocket.
Qin Ye walked over, reached into the inner bag, and touched a cold and hard oblate jade box. He took it out and opened it, and a faint medicinal fragrance that was several times purer than the bone-strengthening elixir overflowed. Inside the jade box, it was covered with soft silk, and lying quietly on it was an elixir the size of a longan, with a warm color and a faint glow.
Body Tempering Pill! And the quality is good, at least mid-range.
"Sure enough." Qin Ye's lips curled up slightly. Zhao Kuo did have one on his body. It might have been given to him by Zhao Gang, or he might have stolen it. This saves trouble.
He put away the body-tempering pill and was about to leave. Zhao Kuo suddenly turned over on the bed and muttered vaguely: "Xiao Cui... my pill... is very valuable... don't lose it..." As he said that, he subconsciously touched his side, as if he wanted to confirm something.
title_en: Chapter 003: Visiting the Zhao Mansion at night to obtain the elixir Chapter 004: Destroying the temple to save a woman with a broken leg
